comment: battery-tiers: suite -> the app files (src/ paths, npm:<package>) it executes beyond the boot floor (floor = per file, the function count the quietest floor_pct % of suites reached). Read by `battery-desk.cjs tiers` to pick tier 1 by coverage. REGENERATE after a release whose union added suites or moved files (every few releases, or when `tiers` reports many unmapped suites): both halves with E2E_COVERAGE=1 on pc slots (RELEASING.md / lanes rules, the battery section), then `node scripts/ci/battery-desk.cjs map build <out-A> <out-B>`; `--merge` adds suites from a focused run to the committed map without rebuilding the floor.
